summary: Runs Python callbacks each cook to generate or modify CHOP channel data, with default docked callbacks for cook, setupParameters, and onPulse.
key_concepts: Script CHOP runs Python callbacks every time the CHOP cooks, making it the custom procedural CHOP generator path.
A new Script CHOP is created with a docked DAT containing cook, onPulse, and setupParameters callback methods.
The cook callback runs each cook, setupParameters runs from the Setup Parameters pulse, and onPulse responds to custom pulse parameters.
Because Script CHOP can read data from anywhere, TouchDesigner tracks broad dependencies and can recook when referenced operators, parameters, or nodes change.
Script CHOP supports NumPy array conversion to and from CHOP channels through CHOP Class workflows.
Use Script CHOP when custom channel generation is needed; prefer built-in CHOPs when a standard operator expresses the transform.

key_params.note: Allow external scripts to update the CHOP outside cook without locking

key_params.name: exporttable
key_params.note: DAT table used by DAT table export methods

common_gotchas: Default docked callbacks are cook, onPulse, and setupParameters.
Because Script CHOP can read from anywhere, dependency detection is conservative and can cause recooks when referenced operators or parameters change.
Use numpyArray() workflows for efficient conversion between CHOP channels and NumPy arrays.
Generated plans should create or attach the callbacks DAT explicitly; an empty Script CHOP is not useful.
Prefer built-in CHOPs for simple transforms; use Script CHOP for custom channel generation or procedural dependencies.
